decision: The repair is reported complete at no charge, but three closure checks are outstanding, so the request stays open on hold rather than being closed. facts.statement: Tenant reported on 24/09/2026 that the shower pull knob is broken and the cap comes off each use at Flat 13, 73 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 6ZZ.
The landlord (Sawyer) approved instructing a contractor in their own reply 'Yes please!' on 25/09/2026.
Keystone Services was assigned and briefed, and the tenant was told who was attending, on 25/09/2026.
A visit was confirmed with tenant and provider for 29/09/2026 09:00-09:30, and later re-booked to 09:30 Wednesday 4 November after a part was ordered.

The provider reported on 07/11/2026 that the job is complete, a new bath tap was fitted, and there is no charge because the tap he fitted in February was faulty; the agency recorded the task as completed without payment.
No quote or priced spend was ever put to the landlord, because the provider carried out the work at no cost under his own guarantee; the landlord also noted the taps are under guarantee.
The landlord asked for photos of the works and raised concern about the elapsed time; the agency chased the provider for photos on 07/11/2026 but none have been received.
On 14/10/2026 the tenant reported a further symptom to the provider: shower and tap running simultaneously when a button is pressed; no record confirms this was resolved.
No management key was issued; the tenant gave access directly to the provider at agreed slots.
